prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reference-faithful 3D game environment concept for the existing MillOS Dead Dino convenience shop. Image 1 is the current interior layout reference and edit target. Image 2 is the current checkout reference. Keep the same camera, room dimensions, dark timber shelving on the left, two-door drinks fridge straight ahead, orange/red and blue twin slush machine on the right, low hot-dog grill, checkout body and shop's orange/charcoal/cream identity. Upgrade the visible existing contents so the interior feels like a lovingly authored game location rather than greybox primitives. Give the same drinks rounded bottle shoulders, narrow necks, contrasting screw caps and cream label bands with restrained fruit emblems; keep the four drink colours. Fill the existing shelves more convincingly with small varied folded paper cartons and crimped snack packets, all standing on their shelves, with simple cream printed panels. Fridge has a vent grille, shelf price rails and restrained neutral glass. Slush dispenser has round clear hoppers with red/blue contents, two round lids, black taps, a drip tray and a seated counter. Grill gets rounded food ends, stainless rollers and a thin framed clear splash cover. Refine the retained low register body with a small angled operator keypad, receipt slot and inset dark customer LCD, without inventing a freestanding monitor. Cream and charcoal square floor tiles, warm neutral functional ceiling light, soft grounded contact shadows and subtle material response. Keep the existing overall scale, equipment locations, shop opening, red roof and exterior unchanged. Render plausible game geometry with clear construction, not photographic clutter. No people, no new room, no neon, no fantasy inventions, no new brands, no added advertising slogans, no technical captions. Concept should be achievable using instanced authored geometry and one bounded interior light.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a four-panel game-asset concept sheet based closely on this exact MillOS market stall. Keep its narrow timber counter, three shallow wooden trays, four dark corner posts, red and cream striped pitched canvas, scalloped valance, size and proportions. Each panel shows the same stall from the same three-quarter customer side, close enough to read the stock. Improve construction by terminating the posts under the awning and showing small timber rafters, without changing the silhouette. Four existing trades: first a greengrocer, apples with stalks and leaves plus leafy cabbages; second a dairy seller, golden cheese wheels with rind bands, cut wedges and small wrapped rounds; third a baker, scored crusty loaves and small round rolls with a tied flour sack; fourth an autumn harvest, lobed orange pumpkins with stems, squashes and pears. Stock rests on the existing tray floors and stays below the canopy. Keep handmade stylized low-poly game character, moderately detailed silhouettes and natural muted material colours. No people, no new furniture, no lamps, no signage, no readable words, no captions, no new awnings or changes to the surrounding village. Clean neutral daylight, game-render concept rather than a photograph. Reference image is the exact existing model and layout to refine.
